items.name: Depreciation (13 %/year)
items.note: The car keeps losing the same share of its value each year. It went from 180 000 to 130 000 kr in 29 months, which is about 12.6 %/year (13 % used). Value after 3 years = 130 000 × 0.87³ ≈ 85 600 kr, so it loses ≈ 44 400 kr over 36 months = ≈ 1 233 kr/month. Change value, % or months to test other assumptions.

items.name: Missed return
items.note: Money tied up in the car, compounded yearly over the chosen months: (amount x (1 + rate)^(months/12) - amount) / months. Earlier it was left out on purpose, since it is uncertain that the money would be invested. For reference, over 36 months at 7 %: 180 000 kr = 1 125 kr/month, 130 000 kr = 813 kr/month.

specs.source: Luggage 335 l (1 032 l folded) comes from press/web pages seen only as search-result summaries (Vi Bilägare, Business Car, Auto Świat); Volvo's own spec sheet was not read, and it is unknown what the 335 measures (to the cover or higher). Length/width from the same pages; height is 1 420-1 445 mm depending on the source. Power, gearbox and equipment depend on your exact V40 (D2/D3, manual or automatic, options): fill them in. Luggage to the roof with the seats up, 402 l: given by the user, and Parkers also lists 402 l seats up; Volvo's own sheet was not read. The 335 l is then probably the figure up to the cover.

items.note: Assumption: a used set of 4 winter wheels (rims and tyres), about 8 000 kr, bought once and spread over the 36 months. A new car needs its own rims, which is why this costs more than the V40's tyres alone. The lease car's own summer tyres are assumed new or included.

specs.source: Toyota Sverige spec sheet YARX_24 (August 2024). Hybrid 130 = 130 hp / 96 kW, CVT. Luggage from Toyota's own table for the Active (front-wheel drive), as pasted by the user: 350 l up to the luggage cover (the figure used here, to match the other cars' 'up to the cover' figures), 397 l with the rear seats up, 460 l to the roof with 5 seats, 1 097 l to the roof with the seats folded. Luggage compartment: 1 402 mm wide, 785 mm long behind row 2, 852 mm high to the roof (AWD-i is 320 l). Length 4 172-4 197 mm, height 1 585-1 595 mm. Backkamera and Farthållare aktiv Plus (ACC) are standard on Active. The sheet has no parking-sensor line for any trim: a Danish dealer lists them as an option, some used Swedish Active cars have them. 2024 sheet, check the 2026 model.

specs.source: Power/gearbox from evkx.net and bilweb; luggage 318 l (plus ~7 l front) from ONE used-car ad, not from Volvo, measure unknown; dimensions from carshow360 (width there includes mirrors). Rear camera and rear sensors are listed for Core Single Motor by Volvo Car Retail and Brandt Bil; front sensors by only one of them. No source I could open states adaptive cruise / Pilot Assist for Core, and volvocars.com blocked automated access: check the configurator. Range 337 km (WLTP, 'upp till') is from Rejmes' page for the Core Single Motor, model year 2027; evkx.net gives 344 km for the Single Motor (about 49 kWh usable). This is not the Long Range version.

Skoda Sverige's price list for the Kamiq (offer valid to 2026-12-15) and skoda.se. Engine 1.0 TSI 116 hp, 6-speed manual or 7-speed DSG (DSG assumed, as the V40 is an automatic: check your quote). Standard on Selection: 'ACC - radarbaserad adaptiv farthållare' and 'Parkeringssensorer bak'. 'Backkamera' and 'Parkeringssensorer fram och bak' are in the Convenience package (8 800 kr), which the cheapest 'Selection Explore' offer (289 000 kr) includes: if your quote is plain Selection, the camera and the front sensors are extra cost. Luggage 400 l / 1 395 l folded from skoda.se (it does not say what 400 l is measured to). Length 4 249 mm and height 1 559 mm from skoda.se; the width 1 793 mm is without mirrors and not on Skoda's page (the page says 1 988 mm with mirrors).

Skoda Sverige's price list for the Octavia Combi dated 8 October 2026. The standard equipment of Selection (the cheapest trim) includes 'Adaptiv farthållare, ACC', 'Backkamera' and 'Parkeringssensorer fram och bak'. Engine 1.5 TSI 116 hp, 6-speed manual or (1.5 TSI m-HEV) 7-speed DSG: DSG assumed, check your quote. Luggage 640 l / 1 700 l folded and length 4 698 mm, height 1 468 mm from skoda.se (Combi; a Liftback has less luggage, so check which body your quote is). Skoda does not say what the 640 l is measured to. The width 1 829 mm is without mirrors and not on Skoda's page (it says 2 003 mm with mirrors).

Bilia's offer page names it 'Volvo EX30 P5 Plus MY27 Long Range' (offer valid during Bilia Days 14-18 October 2026) and lists 'Adaptiv farthållare, parkeringskamera' and 'upp till 476 km räckvidd'. The page does not say whether the camera is a rear or a 360 camera. Front and rear parking sensors are from Ahlberg Bil's listing of the Extended Range Plus Edition ('parkeringshjälp fram och bak', also Pilot Assist): another dealer, not Bilia. Power 272 hp / 200 kW is for the EX30 Single Motor (not stated on Bilia's page). Luggage and dimensions are copied from the other EX30 row (same body; the 318 l is from one used-car ad).

Toyota Sverige's spec sheet 'Toyota C-HR specifikationer & utrustning' (March 2024), for the cheapest version, the 1.8 Hybrid 140 Active (assumed: the app does not say which trim your quote is). 1.8 Hybrid 140 hp / 103 kW with a hybrid transmission (CVT). Luggage 388 l with the seats up under the luggage cover (same measure as the Yaris Cross's 350 l), 1 155 l with the seats folded up to the roof; the figure to the roof with the seats up is not on the sheet. Length 4 362 mm, width 1 832 mm, height 1 558-1 564 mm. 'Backkamera' and 'Farthållare, intelligent aktiv (iACC)' are standard on all trims including Active. Parking sensors front and rear are standard from Style up but marked '-' (not available) for Active, and none of the options packages can be ordered on Active. 2024 sheet: check the current model.
